tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included; this is the project's current recorded decision. For testing, the project uses self-signed certificates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development included, and that testing uses self-signed certificates.

Those two statements come from the project's recorded decisions #30 and #31. The record that had disabled verification in development (#12) was retired by #30, so the file doesn't mention it. I didn't run any tests or checks on the file.

Muninn also flags #30 and #31 as conflicting with other active records (#20 and #21, the Rustls and OpenSSL decisions). Those concern the TLS library, not the verification setting, so I left them out. If you want them resolved, say which one stands.

Muninn's heartbeat is also reporting hooks that started and never finished (20 of them), which suggests a hook is exceeding its timeout. It doesn't affect this file.
